title: Giving Up a Pass and Trip Protection Plan and Settling Its Account
content:
A household that gives up the Pass and Trip Protection plan it holds settles the plan's protection account in
the same step. The plan moves to the given-up state, the record carries why the household gave it up and the
day cover last stood, and the plan's protection account is left standing at the amount confirmed, so the
household knows exactly what remains owed on the plan. Cover stops on the plan from that day, and the state,
the reason and the amount left standing are visible whenever the plan is read back.

What the plan's premium account is left standing at is worked out only after every instalment of premium that
has fallen due on the plan stands raised on the protection account.

What the plan's premium account is left standing at is settled only once the charge the plan owes for being
given up stands raised on the protection account.

**How the plan is given up.** The tool `confirm_plan_giveup_9d16ef5f` is a tool of the household's own. The
desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it on the plan they hold.

**What is passed to it.**

- `protection_plan_id` — the reference number of the protection plan the household is giving up, as the
  protection plan lookup returns it for this household.
- `cancellation_reason` — why the household gives the plan up, exactly one of: `guest_request` where the
  household simply asks to end the cover; `no_reason_given` where they end it without saying why;
  `covered_holding_cancelled` where the holding the plan is written over has itself been given up;
  `non_payment` where the collective ends it because the premium went unpaid; `collective_error` where it is
  unwound because the collective wrote it in error; `none` where the plan has not been given up at all.
- `closing_premium_balance_usd` — what the plan's protection account is left standing at, in USD, given to 2
  decimal places as a plain number such as 12.34 with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; it is
  stored to the cent exactly as passed.

**What comes back.** A single line of confirmation text naming the protection plan, the reason recorded, the
day cover last stood and the amount the protection account is left standing at in USD to the cent. The line
beginning with the word Given is the receipt that the plan was given up; any other wording means the plan
still stands.
